title: David Smith's Personalized Medication Adherence Plan
content:
Strategies to enhance David's medication adherence:
- Utilize a pill organizer to manage multiple medications and reduce missed doses.
- Set up digital reminders on David's phone to take medications at the correct times each day.
- Integrate medication times with David's daily activities, such as having breakfast or preparing for bed.
- Schedule monthly check-ins to evaluate David's adherence, address any side effects, and adjust the treatment plan as needed.
